podcast.title: Mother of Danny Harrison
podcast.body: Olivia Harrison is the mother of Danny Harrison, the only child she had with George Harrison. "Danny Harrison is the only child of George and Olivia."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music

xref.title: Musical Offspring and Creator
xref.body: Danny Harrison is the only child of George and Olivia Harrison. He is a performer, a composer for film and television, and a record producer. He was friends with James McCartney, Zach Starkey, and Sean Lennon, and they discussed forming a band. "Danny Harrison is the only child of George and Olivia. He's a performer, a composer for film and television and a record producer. He eventually became friends with Danny Harrison, son of George, Zach Starky, son of Ringo, and Sean Lennon, son of John. They floored with the idea of forming their own band. Imagine that, but nothing ever came of it."

srcs.source: The Ongoing History of New Music
